svg.title: From the support desk to my own studio. 2018: IT technician, Senac; 2019: IT apprentice, Araujo Abreu; 2020: Systems analysis, Impacta; 2021: Support analyst, Grupo In Press; 2025: Front-end developer, Grupo In Press; 2026: Founder and CEO, Click..
svg.text: From the support desk to my own studio.
Seven years of learning what breaks, then building things that don’t.
